quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: One-off and recurring items kept separate, and one-click acceptance: contract, first-payment invoice and deal won.
quotes.readOnly: Read-only: a partner can create, send and accept quotes.

list.searchPlaceholder: Search by number, title or client…
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No quotes} one {# quote} other {# quotes}}
list.noResultsBody: Try another search or remove the status filter.
list.keyboardHint: <kbd>J</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd> to move · <kbd>Enter</kbd> to open · <kbd>C</kbd> to create
list.emptyBody: This is where quotes live: one-off items, fees and usage-based prices, each kept separate. When one is accepted, its contract and first-payment invoice are created and the deal is marked as won.
list.emptyHint: or press <kbd>C</kbd> from the list; you can also start from a deal in the pipeline

editor.numberPending: No number: it's assigned when it's sent
editor.readOnly: Read-only: a partner can edit, send and accept quotes.
editor.frozenAccepted: Accepted: it stays frozen exactly as it was accepted. To change anything, duplicate it.
editor.frozenRejected: Declined: it can no longer be edited. Duplicate it to prepare another version, or mark it as accepted if the client changes their mind.
editor.sentEditHint: It's already been sent: if you change anything, send it again so the client has the right version.
editor.acceptConfirm: A contract signed today is created, with its lines, issuer and payment plan; the deal is marked as won and the quote is frozen.
editor.acceptConfirmInvoice: The draft invoice for the first payment ({amount}) is also prepared.
editor.acceptConfirmNoInvoice: There's no payment on acceptance: invoices will come from the contract.
editor.acceptConfirmExpired: Heads up: its validity has already expired.
editor.rejectConfirm: Has the client declined it? Give the reason if you know it.
editor.rejectReasonPlaceholder: Price, timelines, they went with another agency…
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? This can't be undone.
editor.newClientHint: The client “{name}” will be created when you save.
editor.dealHint: When the quote is accepted, the deal is marked as won.
editor.issuerHint: Who will invoice the contract once it's accepted.
editor.issuerPending: This SL isn't incorporated yet: it can't issue invoices until its registration date.
editor.languageHint: The language of the PDF and the email. By default, the client's.
editor.linesHint: One-off, monthly, yearly and usage-based items are kept separate, here and in the PDF. Prices excl. VAT.
editor.planHint: How the one-off amount is paid. A first payment “on acceptance” is invoiced as soon as the client accepts.
editor.notesPlaceholder: Scope, delivery timelines, what's not included…
editor.acceptedToastInvoice: Quote accepted: contract created and first-payment draft ready to review
editor.acceptedToastWarning: Quote accepted and contract created, but the first-payment invoice couldn't be prepared: {error}
editor.duplicatedToast: Quote duplicated: it's a new draft

lines.irpfHint: Subject to IRPF withholding when invoiced (depending on the issuer and the client).
lines.startsOnHint: Empty: it starts on the day the quote is accepted.
lines.billingDayHint: Empty: day {day} of each month, the organization's default.
lines.empty: Add what you're going to quote: a one-off payment, a monthly or yearly fee, or a usage-based price.

groupHints.one_off: Charged according to the payment plan
groupHints.usage: Every time it's used, at this price

plan.empty: No payment plan yet: choose a common one or add the payments.
plan.label: Payment

whenHints.on_accept: Invoiced as soon as it's accepted: the draft is ready to issue.
whenHints.on_delivery: A partner invoices it from the contract on delivery.
whenHints.date: Automatic billing prepares it on that day.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Each item on its own, incl. VAT.
summary.empty: Add lines to see the totals.
summary.usageHint: {count, plural, one {# usage-based price} other {# usage-based prices}}: invoiced according to usage
summary.firstInvoice: On acceptance, the invoice for “{label}” is prepared: {amount}.
summary.validUntilDerived: If you send it today, it will be valid until {date}.

pdf.title: PDF
pdf.unsaved: Save the quote to see its PDF.
pdf.stale: There are unsaved changes: the PDF doesn't show them yet.

send.title: Send “{title}”
send.description: The email is in {language}, the quote's language. Review it before sending.
send.toHint: The client's billing contacts. Separate several with commas.
send.noRecipients: The client has no contacts with an email: type who to send it to.
send.subject: Subject
send.attachmentDraft: The quote PDF is attached, already with its number.
send.numberHint: When sent, it gets its number (P, the year and a sequence number) and stops being a draft.
send.markSentHint: Gives it its number without sending the email, in case you deliver it by hand or some other way.

activity.title: Activity
activity.noEmails: It hasn't been sent by email yet.

notFound.title: This quote doesn't exist
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.

validation.clientRequired: Choose a client or type a new one
validation.quantity: A quantity greater than 0, with 3 decimals at most
validation.endsBeforeStart: It can't end before it starts
validation.futureDate: It can't have a future date
validation.validBeforeIssue: It can't be earlier than the date
validation.planRequired: With one-off items, a payment plan is needed
validation.planInvalid: Check the payments in the plan
validation.planOrder: The payment on acceptance has to be the first one
validation.planTotal: The payments must add up to exactly 100%
validation.emails: Enter between 1 and 10 valid emails, separated by commas

errors.reference: The deal, client or issuer don't match: check that the deal belongs to that client.
errors.quoteFrozen: An accepted quote can't be modified: duplicate it to prepare another one.
errors.quoteNotEditable: A declined quote can't be modified: duplicate it to prepare another version.
errors.quoteChanged: Someone changed this quote while you were editing it. Reload and try again.
errors.quoteNotDraft: Only drafts can be deleted: a sent quote is declined or duplicated.
errors.quoteStatusInvalid: A sent quote doesn't go back to draft.
errors.quoteFutureDate: A quote can't have a future date.
errors.quoteValidityPast: The validity date has already passed: change it before sending.
errors.quoteAlreadyAccepted: This quote has already been accepted.
errors.quoteLineDates: A line ends before the contract starts: check its dates.
errors.quoteNotSent: A draft can't be declined: delete it or send it first.
errors.paymentPlanInvalid: Check the payment plan: each payment with its label, its percentage and, if it's on a date, the date.
errors.paymentPlanRequired: With one-off items, a payment plan is needed.
errors.paymentPlanTotal: The payments in the plan must add up to exactly 100%.
errors.paymentPlanOrder: The payment on acceptance has to be the first in the plan.
errors.lineIdRequired: Each line needs its identifier. Reload and try again.

email.subject: Quote: {title} · {issuer}
email.usage: Usage-based services: according to usage, at the prices shown

templates.title: Quote templates
templates.description: Your generic quotes (web, marketing, ads, software…) with their lines and “from” prices, ready to start a new quote in seconds.
templates.empty: No templates yet. Open a quote and press “Save as template”.
templates.archiveConfirm: Archive “{name}”? It will no longer be offered; existing quotes don't change.
templates.uses: {count, plural, =0 {Not used yet} one {Used once} other {Used # times}}

fields.name: Name
fields.summaryHint: For you: it doesn't appear in the PDF.
fields.title: Quote title

saveAs.title: Save as template
saveAs.description: This quote's lines, text and payment plan become a template for the next ones.

editSheet.title: Edit template
editSheet.description: Lines change by saving another quote as this template.

errors.nameTaken: There is already a template with that name.
errors.noLines: The quote has no lines to save.

landing.title: Proposal landing page
landing.description: The page where the client saw the proposal.
landing.emptyDescription: If the proposal was sent as a landing page, record its address here.
landing.urlHint: Must start with https. Leave empty if only the PDF was sent.
landing.empty: This proposal was sent as a PDF only.
landing.invalid: The landing page must be an https address.
landing.proposalPdfHint: Cover, numbered scope and prices. It does not replace the formal quote, which is the one that gets accepted.
